verdicts.title: Stoffbezogene Schutzmaßnahmen begründen

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Stoffbezogene Schutzmaßnahmen begründen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für eine vorgegebene chemische Tätigkeit aus Stoffgefahren und Arbeitsplatzbedingungen passende Schutzmaßnahmen begründen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can justify suitable precautions for a specified chemical activity from the substance hazards and workplace conditions.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Stoffbezogene Schutzmaßnahmen begründen
resourceLinks.description: Comicartige Zuordnung von Spritzgefahr zur Schutzbrille und Dämpfen zum Abzug.
resourceLinks.altText: Zwei große Bildpaare zeigen passende Schutzmaßnahmen: Bei Spritzgefahr schützen geschlossene Schutzbrillen die Augen; Dämpfe einer vorgegebenen Tätigkeit werden im Abzug zurückgehalten. Die Zuordnung richtet sich nach der konkreten Gefahr und dem Arbeitsplatz.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: The two hazard-to-control pairs are correct orientation examples: closed goggles cover the eyes for splash protection, and the vapor source belongs inside the fume hood. The standalone vapor flask is a hazard pictogram, with no actor inhaling or manipulating it. The hood sash leaves a lower working aperture, and inward arrows indicate containment rather than vapor release into the room. No universal glove rule, fabricated hazard label, flame or respirator substitution appears.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: Goggle frames enclose both eyes and remain separate from the face; the lab coat and tied hair are coherent. Flask, hood aperture and lowered sash fit spatially. Arrows in the hood are schematic capture indicators, not a quantitative ventilation diagram.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 the large splash, goggled face, flask and fume hood remain distinct. Gefahr → Schutz, Spritzer, Schutzbrille, Dämpfe and Abzug are readable; no tiny safety qualification carries the meaning. At 680×383 all objects, directions and umlauts remain clear.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The only visible actor wears enclosed goggles with tied hair. There are no notes or instruments being read from a reversed actor perspective.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: The image illustrates two hazard-matched measures; it does not replace a substance hazard assessment, workplace instruction or the complete protective measures required by the specific activity.

verdicts.title: Vorgegebene Entsorgungswege begründet auswählen

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Vorgegebene Entsorgungswege begründet auswählen
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Select specified waste routes with reasons
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einen eindeutig bestimmten Chemikalienrest anhand seiner Eigenschaften und einer örtlichen Entsorgungsanweisung den vorgesehenen Sammelweg begründet auswählen und fehlende entscheidungsrelevante Angaben benennen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: For an identified chemical residue, the learner can select the specified collection route using its properties and a local disposal instruction, and identify missing information needed for a decision.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Vorgegebene Entsorgungswege begründet auswählen
resourceLinks.description: Ein eindeutig bestimmter Rest wird nach örtlicher Anweisung dem passenden Sammelbehälter zugeordnet; unklare Angaben werden zuerst geklärt.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine örtliche Anweisung ordnet Rest A dem Behälter A zu. Lernende und Lehrkraft prüfen die bekannte Restbezeichnung und die Anweisung. Ein getrenntes unbekanntes Gefäß mit Fragezeichen bleibt ungeklärt und wird keinem Sammelweg zugeordnet.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: The image selects the A route only for the identified Rest A under an explicit instruction. The separate question-mark bottle receives the instruction Erst klären and no disposal arrow. Capped containers and absence of pouring, mixing, drains or domestic bins avoid an unsafe universal disposal rule. The selected route is local and symbolic rather than a claim that any chemical of a physical state shares one waste class.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The wall instruction maps Rest A to Behälter A and depicts a single A collection container; the foreground Rest A bottle and separate unknown bottle are physically distinct. The teacher points to the route while the unknown remains unresolved.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 the A labels, route arrow, question mark and Erst klären remain readable; the teacher and learner retain their separation. At 680×383 the instruction and closed caps are unambiguous. Background glassware does not dominate the disposal decision.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: Both actors wear goggles. The instruction is on a wall panel available to them, not a paper facing away from its reader. The notebook has unlettered lines and no demonstrably reversed scientific notation.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: No concrete chemical properties or authorized disposal recipe are supplied; the diagram is a decision orientation and cannot authorize disposal without identifying the residue and applying the actual local instruction.

verdicts.title: Lösungen nach Arbeitsanweisung herstellen

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Lösungen nach Arbeitsanweisung herstellen
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Prepare solutions from a working instruction
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann mit zugelassenen Stoffen und einer bereitgestellten Arbeitsanweisung eine homogene Lösung herstellen und die ausgeführten Arbeitsschritte sowie das Ergebnis dokumentieren.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: Using permitted substances and a supplied working instruction, the learner can prepare a homogeneous solution and document the performed steps and result.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Lösungen nach Arbeitsanweisung herstellen
resourceLinks.description: Drei comicartige Schritte zeigen Messen, Rühren und Dokumentieren nach bereitgestellter Arbeitsanweisung.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine vorgegebene Arbeitsanweisung führt vom Abmessen zugelassener Stoffe über das Rühren einer homogenen Lösung zum Dokumentieren der Arbeitsschritte und der klaren Lösung im eigenen Heft.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: A supplied work instruction controls the sequence Messen → Rühren → Dokumentieren. Separate ordinary salt and water are followed by a visibly uniform, transparent liquid without bottom solid, layers or reaction bubbles. A glass stirring rod is inside the liquid and a final beaker observation is documented. No flame, tasting, drinking, improvised hazardous reaction or disappearance of matter is shown.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The vessel and salt dish depict readiness rather than numerical measurement; no false graduations or invented quantities appear. The rod enters through the beaker opening and is gripped outside the vessel. The result sketch agrees with the homogeneous liquid shown in the stirring panel.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 all three actions, connecting arrows, salt/water symbols, rod and notebook remain recognizable. Messen, Rühren, Dokumentieren and Nach Arbeitsanweisung are readable. At 680×383 the hands, clear liquid and check marks are unambiguous.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The notebook is viewed over the writer shoulder; its top, binding, sketch and pen are oriented toward the writer at the lower edge. The rod hand approaches from above and does not pass through the glass. Faces are omitted in this close-up and no claim about unseen eye protection is made.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: The ungraduated measuring-vessel icon is conceptual and does not teach accurate measurement or an actual recipe. Amounts, permitted materials, method and full documentation remain supplied by the working instruction and ordinary learning content.

verdicts.title: Löslichkeit und Sättigung aus Daten erklären

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Löslichkeit und Sättigung aus Daten erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain solubility and saturation from data
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einen vorgegebenen Stoff, ein Lösungsmittel und eine Temperatur aus Mengen- und Beobachtungsdaten erklären, ob eine Lösung gesättigt oder ungesättigt ist und welche zusätzliche Stoffmenge sich unter diesen Bedingungen noch lösen kann.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: For a specified substance, solvent and temperature, the learner can use quantities and observations to explain whether a solution is saturated or unsaturated and how much further solute can dissolve under those conditions.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Löslichkeit und Sättigung aus Daten erklären
resourceLinks.description: Zwei Lösungen desselben Stoffes bei gleicher Temperatur: ungesättigt mit weiterer Lösemöglichkeit und gesättigt mit verbleibendem Bodensatz.
resourceLinks.altText: Bei 20 Grad Celsius zeigen zwei Gefäße denselben Stoff und dieselbe Lösungsmittelmenge. Links kann sich noch Stoff lösen; rechts bleibt bei Sättigung ein ungelöster Feststoffrest am Boden. Die Flüssigkeit darüber ist in beiden Fällen homogen.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: Both cases use the same stated material and 20 °C; the two vessels have matching liquid levels and homogeneous clear liquid portions. The ungesättigt case offers additional solute on a spoon, while the gesättigt case coexists with a separate undissolved solid pile. This is a correct fixed-condition equilibrium example and does not portray undissolved chunks as the homogeneous liquid itself.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The matching vessel geometry, liquid levels and equal thermometer pictograms do not smuggle in a change of solvent amount or temperature. Crystals remain on the spoon or at the bottom. There is no heating, melting, reaction, false particle bonding or numeric solubility datum.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 both 20 °C labels, Ungesättigt/Gesättigt, Noch löslich/Rest bleibt and the spoon versus bottom-solid contrast are readable and distinct. At 680×383 the homogeneous upper liquid and separated solid are clear. The common heading remains legible.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The observers wear goggles and do not manipulate the material. Thermometers are schematic case indicators, not instruments shown being read from the wrong side. No handwritten notes appear.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: The graphic is qualitative orientation, not proof from observations alone that any arbitrary residue is a saturation equilibrium. A saturated solution need not always have excess solid; the whole goal still requires specified solute/solvent and quantitative data to determine additional dissolvable mass.

verdicts.title: Massenanteile berechnen und deuten

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Massenanteile berechnen und deuten
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus den Massen der Bestandteile den Massenanteil eines Stoffes berechnen und als Anteil an der Gesamtmasse des Gemisches deuten.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can calculate a substance mass fraction from the constituent masses and interpret it as a share of the total mixture mass.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Massenanteile berechnen und deuten
resourceLinks.description: Ein korrekt proportionierter Massenbalken zeigt 20 Gramm Salz und 80 Gramm Wasser als insgesamt 100 Gramm Gemisch.
resourceLinks.altText: Ein Balken aus fünf gleich großen Massenabschnitten enthält einen Abschnitt Salz mit 20 Gramm und vier Abschnitte Wasser mit zusammen 80 Gramm. Der gesamte Balken umfasst 100 Gramm; der Salzanteil an dieser Gesamtmasse beträgt 20 Prozent.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: The total mass contains both components: 20 g salt plus 80 g water gives 100 g mixture, and 20 g / 100 g = 0.20 = 20 %. The visual bar has five near-equal sections with exactly one salt section and four water sections; it therefore represents the correct 1:4 constituent mass ratio and 1:5 salt-to-total ratio.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The total bracket spans the complete five-section bar. The 80 g Wasser label belongs across the four blue sections, rather than one section. The dish and jug are supporting material symbols and carry no volume graduations or implied mass-volume conversion.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 the single purple section, four blue sections, 20 g Salz, 80 g Wasser, 100 g gesamt and the large 20 g / 100 g = 20 % relation remain readable. At 680×383 bar boundaries, bracket and units remain clear.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The actors observe a conceptual mass diagram rather than carry out a hazardous operation. No reading instrument, written notes or technical scale is shown from a reversed perspective.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: The worked numerical relationship illustrates the orientation concept only. It is not assessment evidence, a solution record or an instruction to infer mass from the decorative vessel sizes.

verdicts.title: Volumenanteile berechnen und deuten

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Volumenanteile berechnen und deuten
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus den Volumina der Bestandteile vor dem Mischen deren Volumenanteile berechnen und die Bezugsgröße korrekt benennen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can calculate volume fractions from constituent volumes before mixing and name the reference quantity correctly.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Volumenanteile berechnen und deuten
resourceLinks.description: Fünf gleiche Ausgangsvolumina zeigen vor dem Mischen ein Volumenteil A und vier Volumenteile B.
resourceLinks.altText: Vor dem Mischen enthalten fünf gleiche getrennte Gefäße jeweils 20 Milliliter. Ein violettes Gefäß bildet 20 Milliliter A; vier blaue Gefäße bilden zusammen 80 Milliliter B. Alle fünf Ausgangsvolumina ergeben 100 Milliliter als Bezugsgröße. Der Ausgangsvolumenanteil von A beträgt 20 Prozent; ein Endvolumen der Mischung wird nicht behauptet.

verdicts.modelVersion: not exposed by provided tool trace
verdicts.observedScientificMeaning: Five separate vessels each contain 20 mL before mixing. Exactly one purple vessel is A (20 mL), and four blue vessels together are B (80 mL). The reference bracket includes all five starting volumes, so 20 mL / 100 mL = 20 %. Vor dem Mischen makes the denominator a sum of original constituent volumes and does not claim a final mixture volume or volume additivity after mixing.
verdicts.geometryProportionsUnitsAndLabels: The five vessels have matching internal shapes, baseline and horizontal liquid heights; the equality of 20 mL units is therefore represented in the drawing. The 80 mL B bracket covers four vessels and the 100 mL bracket covers five. The Je 20 mL arrows identify each vessel individually. No false scale ticks or merged final vessel appear.
verdicts.actualResponsiveInspection: At 360×203 all five vessels can be counted and their equal fill is visible; the A and B group labels, Vor dem Mischen, Je 20 mL, reference volume and the percentage relation are readable. At 680×383 group brackets, common height and denominator remain clear.
verdicts.actorFacingNotesAndInstruments: The observers face the vessels; no one reads a reversed scale or written note. The unlettered books have no distracting pseudo-writing, watermark or technical identifier.
verdicts.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly abstract school chemistry cartoon with coherent navy outlines, cream/blue backgrounds and lilac accents. Clear objects, appropriate Sek-I age fit and visual continuity with the two preserved parent JPEG overviews. No visible logo, technical ID, protected character or watermark.
verdicts.altTextAssessment: The candidate alt text matches the visible central objects and relevant scientific distinction; it provides a meaningful non-visual description.
verdicts.scopeLimits: The selected attempt is 2 and the prior attempt is retained; this review judges the current exact pixels. The diagram does not establish the actual mixture final volume, a density relation or mastery.
